notes: Press ↑ in an empty message box to bring back what you sent, and Retry a reply you stopped. Markers stay the same size on screen when you zoom. Export shows a live preview, lets you choose which parts go in, and lets you choose where each file is saved.
notes_zh_tw: 輸入框是空的時候按 ↑ 可以叫回送出過的訊息，停止的回覆可以重試。縮放時，點與線的標記在畫面上維持同樣大小。匯出時有即時預覽，可以選擇要輸出哪些零件，也可以選擇每個檔案存在哪裡。
